tagline: Automated video editing tools for content creators

policies.refund_policy: No refunds are provided after 7 days from the date of purchase.
policies.support: 24/7 live support is available exclusively on the Pro plan. Basic plan users have access to email support during business hours.
policies.free_trial: A 7-day free trial is available for the Pro plan. No credit card required.
policies.cancellation: You can cancel your subscription at any time. Access continues until the end of the billing period.

faq.question: Can I upgrade from Basic to Pro?
faq.answer: Yes, you can upgrade anytime. You will be charged the prorated difference for the remaining billing period.

faq.question: What video formats are supported?
faq.answer: AutoStream supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and MKV input formats. Exports are in MP4 (H.264/H.265).

faq.question: Is there a free plan?
faq.answer: We do not offer a permanent free plan, but we do offer a 7-day free trial of the Pro plan.
